paper.title_en: Constraints on teleparallel gravity with different dark energy parametrizations from DESI DR2 BAO and gravitational wave data
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the cosmological implications of modified teleparallel gravity within the f(T) framework using two dark energy parametrizations: Chevallier Polarski Linder (CPL) and Barboza Alcaniz (BA). We utilize latest high precession observational datasets to place constraints on our model parameters through statistical analysis. With these constraints, we analyze vital cosmological metrics like the deceleration parameter, the effective equation of state, and the Om(z) diagnostic. Our results show that both models successfully describe the late-time acceleration of the Universe. Both models fit the data at a level comparable to flat \Lambda \text{CDM}, however analysis of the results shows that their is not much favourable evidence that shows deviation from the standard cosmology. The model parameters, including H_{0}, n, and \omega _{0}, \omega _{1}, are tightly constrained, with the GR limit excluded at more than 2\sigma , indicating a significant deviation from standard gravity. Dynamically, the \text{CPL} +f(T) model exhibits phantom crossing and evolving dark energy behavior, accompanied by a late-time violation of the null energy condition, while the \text{BA} +f(T) model remains in the non-phantom regime and preserves all energy conditions, ensuring a more stable cosmic evolution. Overall, our analysis demonstrates that f(T) gravity with suitable parametrizations provides a viable and physically consistent alternative to \Lambda \text{CDM}, capable of capturing rich dark energy dynamics while remaining compatible with current high-precision observations.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 本文系统研究f(T)远平行引力框架下两种暗能量参数化（CPL与BA），结合DESI DR2 BAO与引力波数据进行参数约束，并分析减速参数、有效状态方程与Om(z)诊断，属于修改引力主题，理论深度与观测约束分析具有一定价值，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 利用DESI DR2 BAO与引力波数据对不同暗能量参数化下远平行引力的约束
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在f(T)框架内研究修改远平行引力的宇宙学含义，采用两种暗能量参数化：Chevallier Polarski Linder（CPL）与Barboza Alcaniz（BA）。我们利用最新的高精度观测数据集，通过统计分析对模型参数施加约束。借助这些约束，我们分析了减速参数、有效状态方程和Om(z)诊断等关键宇宙学指标。结果表明，两种模型都成功描述了宇宙的晚期加速膨胀。两个模型对数据的拟合程度与平坦\Lambda \text{CDM}相当，然而对结果的分析显示，并没有多少有利证据表明其偏离标准宇宙学。模型参数，包括H_{0}、n以及\omega _{0}、\omega _{1}，被紧密约束，广义相对论极限被排除在超过2\sigma 的水平之外，表明对标准引力存在显著偏离。从动力学上看，\text{CPL} +f(T)模型表现出幻影穿越和演化暗能量行为，并伴有晚期违反零能量条件，而\text{BA} +f(T)模型保持在非幻影区域并满足所有能量条件，从而确保更稳定的宇宙演化。总体而言，我们的分析表明，采用适当参数化的f(T)引力为\Lambda \text{CDM}提供了一种可行且物理上自洽的替代方案，能够刻画丰富的暗能量动力学，同时与当前高精度观测保持兼容。
